description: This file defines the interface Psr17FactoryProviderInterface for the Slim framework, specifying methods for managing a collection of factory class names related to PSR-17 factory provisioning.

classes.name: Psr17FactoryProviderInterface
classes.description: An interface that declares static methods to retrieve, set, and add PSR-17 factory class names.

methods.name: getFactories
methods.description: Returns an array of factory class names as strings.

methods.name: setFactories
methods.description: Sets the list of factory class names from an array of strings.

methods.name: addFactory
methods.description: Adds a single factory class name to the existing list.
